baseline.method: Allowed-action twelve-policy audit through production simulation-worker. Same seeds and actions as ending-balance-audit. No injected capabilities, funds, publications or awards. Policy mixture is not a player win rate or real career probability. Grant-enabled managed test policies are only a reproducible comparison.

eventAndRecoveryOnly.method: Allowed-action twelve-policy audit through production simulation-worker. Same seeds and actions as ending-balance-audit. Focused career scenario allocates actual startup/video activities after graduate entry. No injected capabilities, funds, publications or awards. Policy mixture is not a player win rate or real career probability. Grant-enabled managed test policies are only a reproducible comparison.
eventAndRecoveryOnly.limitations: Institution and lab-mode summaries describe this mixture, not paired causal effects: some fields only support one lab mode. Career scenario uses distinct policies and cannot be added into mixed-scenario denominators.

growthBaseline.method: Five fixed policies through production simulation-worker; no ability, funds, or output injection. All policies intentionally continue into doctoral study and use managed finances to isolate student growth. Random means uniform legal weekly activities, feedback and affordable event options; default accepts proposals and first affordable event options. These are test policies, not human-player or real-world probabilities.
